rationale: Stratified by era, franchise and offensive identity, declared before tuning. Three eras (1970s, 1980s, 2000s), three franchises, three distinct identities: fast motion, half-court star offence, and slow elite defence. Deliberately small because the historical corpus is only 10 fixtures — the alternative was a holdout that consumed the corpus, or one padded with synthetic teams that cannot validate historical accuracy.
limitation: Three fixtures, below the 8-12 the brief targets, because the whole historical corpus is 10.
